newsitem.title: USA: Coastal Physician names interim finance head.
newsitem.headline: Coastal Physician names interim finance head.

text.p: Coastal Physician Group Inc said Monday it named W. Randall Dickerson as interim chief financial officer effective March 17.
Dickerson, 42, will replace Timothy Trost, who has resigned to pursue another business opportunity, it said.
Dickerson is currently chief financial officer of Healthcare Business Resources Inc, Coastal's physician billing and collection services subsidiary.
Dickerson joined Coastal in 1993 and has been corporate controller and, before that, corporate treasurer.

Coastal reiterated in its announcement that it was negotiating with its lenders the possible extension of its outstanding debt beyond July 1 and possible additional financing. It said its discussions with another lender regarding its financing needs are progressing.
It noted, however, that there can be no assurance that additional funds wil be provided by either the existing lenders or an alternate financial source.
